description: Evidence an assessor should ask for. Used by build_questions.py: a subcategory's own prompt (by_subcategory, written by /build-csf-bank Step 6 and checked by an evaluator), else its category's line, else the default.
default: Policy document, tool screenshot, or named process owner

by_category.GV.OC: Strategic plans, board minutes, mission statement
by_category.GV.RM: Risk register, risk appetite statement, risk committee charter
by_category.GV.RR: Org chart, RACI, job descriptions with security responsibilities
by_category.GV.PO: Cybersecurity policy with version history and approval sign-off
by_category.GV.OV: Audit report, management review minutes, KPI dashboard
by_category.GV.SC: Supplier list, vendor contracts with security clauses, TPRM policy
by_category.ID.RA: Risk assessment report, threat model, vulnerability scan results
by_category.ID.IM: Improvement log, lessons-learned records, corrective action register
by_category.PR.AA: IAM policy, MFA config, access review records, PAM tool screenshots
by_category.PR.AT: Training completion records, security awareness metrics, phishing test results
by_category.PR.DS: Data classification policy, DLP config, encryption standards
by_category.PR.PS: Hardening standards, patch management reports, config baselines
by_category.PR.IR: Network architecture diagrams, segmentation rules, capacity and resilience test records
by_category.DE.AE: SIEM alert rules, anomaly detection config, baseline definitions
by_category.DE.CM: Monitoring dashboards, log retention policy, alert tickets
by_category.RS.MA: Incident response plan, escalation matrix, communication templates
by_category.RS.AN: Incident post-mortem reports, forensic tool list, chain of custody
by_category.RS.CO: Breach notification procedures, regulator contact list
by_category.RS.MI: Containment runbooks, eradication procedures, recovery checklists
by_category.RC.RP: Business continuity plan, RTO/RPO targets, recovery test records

by_subcategory.DE.AE-04: The method for estimating the impact and scope of an adverse event, and the latest estimate made for an event, if any, with how it was reviewed and refined.
by_subcategory.DE.AE-06: The alert routing configuration to the security team and response tools, the access arrangement for analysis findings, and the latest alert ticket showing creation, assignment and handling.
by_subcategory.DE.AE-07: The threat intelligence feeds and vulnerability advisory sources in use, how asset inventory data is provided to detection tools, and the latest advisory acted on with the date received and date assessed.
by_subcategory.DE.AE-08: The documented incident criteria, how known false positives are handled, and the latest record of an event assessed against the criteria and the declare or not-declare decision, if any.
by_subcategory.DE.CM-01: The list of monitored network services and segments, network baseline and alert rules, the latest alert report for unauthorized devices, rogue wireless and unusual traffic, and the follow-up record.
by_subcategory.DE.CM-02: The physical monitoring arrangements per site (access logs, cameras, alarms, guards), the latest review of access logs and visitor records, and the record of any tamper checks on locks and alarms.
by_subcategory.DE.CM-03: The list of logs and tools monitoring user and technology activity, the alert rules for unusual access and failed attempts, the latest review record, and any deception accounts or similar monitored.
by_subcategory.DE.CM-06: The list of external providers monitored, how their administration and maintenance sessions are logged and reviewed, the latest monitoring report on cloud and other provider activity, and the latest deviation found, if any.
by_subcategory.GV.OC-01: The current mission and vision statements and the document or briefing showing which cybersecurity risks were identified as able to impede that mission, with the date it was last reviewed.
by_subcategory.GV.OC-02: The register of internal and external stakeholders (leadership, employees, customers, partners, regulators) with their cybersecurity expectations, who owns it, and when it was last updated.
by_subcategory.GV.OC-03: The register of legal, regulatory, privacy and contractual cybersecurity obligations, showing the owner, how changes are tracked, and how each obligation maps to the cybersecurity strategy or policies; the latest update.
by_subcategory.GV.OC-04: The list of critical services and objectives external stakeholders depend on, the criticality criteria used, the resilience objectives (such as recovery time objectives) set for each, and where these were communicated.
by_subcategory.GV.OC-05: The inventory of external dependencies (facilities, cloud services, utilities, suppliers) that support critical services, flagging single points of failure, with the date it was last reviewed and who it was shared with.
by_subcategory.GV.OV-01: The latest management review of the risk strategy outcomes, showing the measures examined, whether the strategy hindered operations, and the adjustments decided, with the date and attendees.
by_subcategory.GV.OV-02: The latest strategy review record that draws on audit findings, role performance reviews and lessons from incidents (if any), showing which strategy or policy changes resulted.
by_subcategory.GV.OV-03: The key performance and key risk indicator dashboard or report, the latest pack presented to senior leadership, and the actions taken from it, covering the whole organisation.
by_subcategory.GV.PO-01: The current cybersecurity risk management policy with its approval record, version history, the date it was published to staff, and the supporting procedures that implement it.
by_subcategory.GV.PO-02: The policy review schedule, the latest review record showing what changed and why (new risks, laws, audit results), and evidence the update was communicated and how enforcement is carried out.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-01: The current cybersecurity risk management objectives with their measures, the strategic planning record or minutes where senior leaders agreed them, and the latest progress report against them.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-02: The approved risk appetite and risk tolerance statements, the measurable thresholds derived from them, how they were communicated, and the date of the latest review.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-03: The enterprise risk register or report showing cybersecurity risks held alongside other enterprise risks, the escalation criteria, and the latest enterprise risk meeting record or agenda with cybersecurity represented.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-04: The documented risk response guidance (criteria for accepting, avoiding, transferring or mitigating risk by data classification, cyber insurance decision, shared responsibility conditions), with approval and last review date.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-05: The risk communication procedure or reporting calendar showing who reports cybersecurity risk to executives, directors and departments (including supplier-related risk), and the latest report issued.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-06: The risk assessment methodology, the risk register template with its scoring and prioritisation criteria, and the latest completed register showing how risks were rated and ranked.
by_subcategory.GV.RM-07: The guidance for identifying strategic opportunities (positive risks) and where they are recorded alongside negative risks, such as an opportunity log or stretch goals, if any, with the latest entry.
by_subcategory.GV.RR-01: The document or board and executive minutes recording leaders' agreed cybersecurity roles and accountabilities, leadership communications on secure and ethical culture, and the latest review of the risk strategy directed to the security lead.
by_subcategory.GV.RR-02: The policy or responsibility matrix (such as a RACI) naming who is accountable for each cybersecurity risk activity, sample job descriptions that include security duties, and how roles were communicated; the latest update.
by_subcategory.GV.RR-03: The cybersecurity budget and staffing plan set against the risk strategy, the latest management review of whether role holders have adequate resources, and any resource gaps recorded with their decisions.
by_subcategory.GV.RR-04: The HR procedures that include security (screening criteria for sensitive roles, onboarding and offboarding steps, security in role descriptions and performance), plus the latest completed screening and offboarding records for sampled staff.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-01: The supply chain risk management strategy, objectives, policies and programme plan with milestones, its approval, owner, and the latest progress or review record.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-02: The document assigning supply chain security roles and responsibilities (policy section or responsibility matrix) for internal teams and for suppliers, customers and partners, and how it was communicated; the latest update.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-03: The mapping or integrated control set linking supply chain risk management to cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, showing supplier risks in the enterprise risk register and the latest improvement review.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-04: The supplier register with criticality ratings, the criticality criteria (such as data sensitivity and operational dependence), and the date it was last reviewed, covering all active suppliers.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-05: The standard supplier security requirements and contract clauses by criticality tier, how compliance is verified, the information-sharing rules, and a recent contract for a critical supplier showing them.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-06: The supplier due diligence procedure and the completed due diligence or risk assessment for the most recent critical supplier onboarded, showing the capabilities and requirements checked before signing.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-07: The supplier assessment schedule by criticality, the latest assessment results or compliance evidence reviewed for critical suppliers, and the records of ongoing monitoring and follow-up actions.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-08: The incident response plan sections covering suppliers (roles, reporting rules and contacts), supplier contract clauses on incident notification, and the latest exercise or incident record that included critical suppliers, if any.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-09: The procurement policy requirements for provenance and integrity of acquired products and services, provenance records for recent critical acquisitions, and the latest risk report to leaders on acquired components.
by_subcategory.GV.SC-10: The supplier exit and termination procedure, end-of-life and obsolescence plans for critical components, and the latest record of supplier access being removed after a contract ended, if any.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-01: The hardware inventory covering IT, mobile, IoT and operational technology devices, how it is kept current (such as network discovery), the owner, and the date of the latest reconciliation.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-02: The inventory of software, services and systems including commercial, open-source and cloud, how it is kept current, its owner, and the latest reconciliation across all platforms.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-03: The current network diagrams and data flow baselines for internal networks, wireless, third-party connections and cloud infrastructure, with the date last updated and who approved them.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-04: The inventory of external services in use (cloud, hosting, outsourced services) with owner and data handled, the step that adds a new service with a security check, and the date of the last review.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-05: The asset prioritisation criteria, the asset list showing each asset's classification and criticality rating, and the latest review or update of those priorities after significant change.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-07: The list of designated data types (such as personal or regulated data), the data inventory with locations, owners and classification labels, and how new instances are discovered; the date of the latest update.
by_subcategory.ID.AM-08: The lifecycle procedures showing security steps at acquisition, deployment, maintenance and disposal, the latest disposal or decommission record, and how unofficial technology use (shadow IT) is found and handled.
by_subcategory.ID.IM-01: The latest self-assessment, audit or third-party assessment report for critical services, the compliance monitoring results, and the improvement actions logged from them with status.
by_subcategory.ID.IM-02: The latest security test, incident response or recovery exercise report, including supplier and internal stakeholder participation, and the improvement actions recorded from it with owners and status.
by_subcategory.ID.IM-03: The latest lessons-learned records from operations (including sessions with suppliers), the annual policy and procedure review record, and the performance metrics trend with improvements derived from them.
by_subcategory.ID.IM-04: The current incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery and vulnerability management plans, each with owner, contacts, escalation criteria, version date, how it was communicated, and the latest review.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-01: The latest vulnerability scan report and the register of identified vulnerabilities with validation status and owners, the scan coverage across assets, and the latest architecture or code security review results.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-02: The list of threat intelligence sources and advisories subscribed to, who reviews them, how they feed security tools, and the latest advisory reviewed with the action taken.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-03: The threat register or threat assessment of internal and external threat actors, the intelligence it draws on, the latest threat hunting report if any, and its last update date.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-04: The risk assessment records estimating likelihood and business impact for threats exploiting identified vulnerabilities, including cascading impacts, showing business participation and the date of the latest assessment.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-05: The latest risk analysis showing inherent risk from threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact, any threat models for key data or systems, and how it set priorities for investment.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-06: The risk treatment plan or register recording the chosen response (accept, transfer, mitigate, avoid) for each risk, owners, due dates, compensating controls, and the latest progress report to leaders.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-07: The change management procedure and the latest approved change records including risk assessment and rollback plan, and the exception register with documented risks, approvals, expiry and follow-up.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-08: The vulnerability disclosure policy and intake channel, the procedure for triage and response with assigned owners, and the latest disclosure received and handled, if any.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-09: The procedure for checking authenticity and integrity of hardware and software before acquisition, and the completed assessment records for the most recent critical products acquired.
by_subcategory.ID.RA-10: The supplier assessment procedure run before acquisition and the completed risk assessment of the most recent critical supplier, showing the requirements it was assessed against and the decision.
by_subcategory.PR.AA-01: The joiner, mover and leaver procedure with the latest access request and revocation records, the credential and key or certificate inventory with issue and revoke dates, and how devices get unique identifiers.
by_subcategory.PR.AA-02: The identity proofing procedure for enrolling people and the latest enrollment record showing what was checked, plus evidence that each person holds their own credential (no shared accounts), with exceptions listed.
by_subcategory.PR.AA-05: The access control policy, the latest user access review for critical systems with revocations made, and the separation-of-duties conflict list for critical business functions, with the date of last review.
by_subcategory.PR.AA-06: The physical access policy and the list of controlled areas, the current authorized-access list for the highest-risk areas, the latest access log extract, and the visitor and escort records for the latest period.
by_subcategory.PR.AT-02: The list of specialized roles needing extra training, the role-based curriculum for each, the latest completion and assessment results including third parties in those roles, and the date of the last refresher.
by_subcategory.PR.DS-10: The standard or design record for protecting data in use (memory clearing, isolation between processes and tenants), and the latest configuration or test result showing it applied to systems handling confidential data.
by_subcategory.PR.DS-11: The backup schedule for critical data and the systems it covers, the latest restore test result, and where offline or offsite copies are kept, including geographic separation.
by_subcategory.PR.IR-01: The network and cloud segmentation diagram showing trust boundaries, firewall or access rule extracts and their latest review, and any zero trust or endpoint health checks applied before access to production.
by_subcategory.PR.IR-04: The capacity monitoring dashboard or report for storage, compute, bandwidth and power, the latest capacity forecast, and the most recent scaling decision made from it.
by_subcategory.PR.PS-01: The hardened configuration baselines for each platform type, the latest baseline review, the check for default settings on install or upgrade, and the latest report of deviations from baseline.
by_subcategory.PR.PS-03: The hardware lifecycle plan with end-of-life and replacement schedule, the list of hardware lacking needed security capabilities, and the latest disposal records showing secure, auditable disposal.
by_subcategory.PR.PS-04: The logging standard, the list of systems and cloud services generating logs and forwarding them to central logging, and a coverage report or extract showing gaps and the latest check.
by_subcategory.PR.PS-06: The secure development standard, the latest pipeline or repository access and integrity settings, recent release security test or vulnerability results, and the procedure for retiring software no longer needed, for organization-developed software if any.
by_subcategory.RC.CO-03: The recovery communication plan naming internal and external stakeholders and critical suppliers, relevant contract or sharing-agreement terms, if any, and the latest recovery status update to leadership or stakeholders, if any.
by_subcategory.RC.CO-04: The public communication and breach notification procedure with approved messaging templates and approvers, and the latest public update issued, if any, or exercise draft.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-01: The recovery section of the incident response plan, the list of people with recovery responsibilities and their authorizations, the evidence they were made aware of it, and the latest recovery record or exercise.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-02: The criteria for selecting recovery actions and the latest recovery plan, if any, showing actions chosen, their scope and priority, and any changes made after reassessing resources.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-03: The procedure for checking backups and restoration assets for compromise and corruption before use, and the latest check result, such as a scan or integrity verification of a backup used in a restore or test.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-04: The business impact analysis and system priority list with service delivery objectives, the restoration order used, and the latest record of owners confirming restoration and post-restore performance monitoring, if any.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-05: The post-restoration verification checklist and the latest completed one, showing checks for compromise, root cause remediation and correctness before systems went back into production, if any, or test result.
by_subcategory.RC.RP-06: The criteria for declaring the end of recovery, the after-action report template, and the latest completed after-action report with lessons learned, if any.
by_subcategory.RS.AN-03: The incident analysis procedure and root cause template, and the latest incident analysis, if any, showing the event timeline, assets involved, causes found and systemic fixes identified.
by_subcategory.RS.AN-06: The procedure for recording responder actions and protecting the record's integrity, the tool or location where incident records are kept, and an extract of the latest incident log, if any, showing who did what and when.
by_subcategory.RS.AN-07: The evidence preservation and chain-of-custody procedure, the tools used to collect incident data and metadata, and the latest chain-of-custody record, if any, or exercise result.
by_subcategory.RS.AN-08: The procedure for estimating an incident's magnitude and searching other systems for compromise, the tools used, and the latest scoping record, if any, showing systems checked and results.
by_subcategory.RS.CO-02: The notification procedure naming who is told, in what order and by when (customers, partners, regulators, law enforcement), the approval step, and the latest notification sent, if any, or exercise record.
by_subcategory.RS.CO-03: The incident communication plan listing internal and external stakeholders, information sharing agreements and supplier contract clauses on incident information, if any, and the latest leadership update or shared incident report, if any.
by_subcategory.RS.MA-01: The incident response plan with roles and third-party contacts, the incident lead designation rule, and the latest incident record, if any, showing the lead named, outside help requested and linked plans started; or the latest exercise report.
by_subcategory.RS.MA-02: The incident intake and triage procedure with the severity criteria, the incident log showing report receipt, validation outcome and severity assigned, and the latest triaged report, if any.
by_subcategory.RS.MA-03: The incident categories and prioritization criteria, the guidance on choosing response strategies, and the latest incident record, if any, showing category, priority and strategy chosen.
by_subcategory.RS.MA-04: The escalation procedure and contact list for internal and external stakeholders, the incident status tracker, and the latest escalation record, if any, or exercise result.
by_subcategory.RS.MA-05: The documented criteria for starting incident recovery, including disruption considerations, and the latest record of a decision to start recovery applying them, if any, or exercise result.
